product_summary: Uttam Blastech Pvt Ltd (uttamblastech.com) is a mining-blasting technology and services company, not a bulk explosives maker. Real product lines per its own Products page: (1) Shock Tube Initiators — battery-powered, remotely operated non-electric spark initiators, 2–5 J spark energy, dual field + handheld unit, Li-ion 7.4V 2500 mAh; (2) VOD meter & Delay Timer — probe-based detonation velocity measurement 10 ps–350 ps, 0–1 s delay, USB, IP65; (3) Seismograph (blast vibration monitoring); (4) FragVision and BestExco digital solutions; (5) Drilling & Blasting Accessories — stemming plugs, blasting mats, liners & spacers, blast hole covers, drill pipes, drill hammers, drill bits / DTH bits. Services (not goods): geological & geophysical investigations, blast design & advisory, compliance & safety, blasting & excavation contracts, mineral asset valuation. Site states it supplies shock tube initiators and consumables to Australia, USA, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, South Africa, Kenya, Indonesia — заявлено, не подтверждено (no customs/B-L line seen; export volumes not researched per role scope).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — claims own R&D and in-house product engineering for initiators/instruments, but the catalogue also carries third-party-branded accessories (BestExco, drill bits/hammers, seismographs) which are typically traded/resold. No explosives-manufacturing licence or bulk explosive (emulsion/ANFO) plant is advertised, so the declared 3603 classification overstates the explosives-manufacturer profile.
comment: Declared HS 360300 = 'Safety fuses; detonating fuses; percussion or detonating caps; igniters; electric detonators' (Ch.36 explosives). Verdict: PARTIAL, not wrong — the flagship shock tube initiator is a non-electric initiation device and, if exported as an explosive article of Ch.36, would sit in 3603.40 (percussion/detonating caps & igniters) or arguably 3603.60 (igniters). However the declared single 6-digit code covers only a fraction of the real catalogue: the battery-powered spark initiator unit, VOD meter/delay timer and seismograph are electrical measuring/instrument goods (8543.70 / 9031.80 / 9027.80), and drill bits, DTH bits, drill pipes, stemming plugs, blasting mats and hole covers are Chapter 82 / 39 / 63 goods. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is mining/blasting-technology and blasting-services (industries listed: mining, dredging, oil & gas, infrastructure) — oil & gas is only an end-market, and it is not a chemicals/explosives producer. Trader signs: resale of branded accessories (BestExco, drill consumables) alongside own products; also a large services component (blasting contracts, blast design, mineral valuation) that has no HS code at all and cannot be captured by 360300. Product lines missing from the declaration: instruments/seismographs, drilling tools, plastic/accessory consumables, software. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground — company is retained, code corrected to the actual mix above; the 3603.40 line should be kept only for the initiator line and additional codes added per shipment. All product facts sourced from https://www.uttamblastech.com/products and https://www.uttamblastech.com/products/shock-tube-initiators (accessed via http_get); export destinations are the company's own claim — заявлено, не подтверждено. No customs line, GST turnover or shipment record was examined in this role; revenue/volumes = null.
